title: Target-open counit composition triangle
statement: For k:X′→X, an open U′ of X′, and any homotopy complex P on X, the open-pullback comparison at Lk*(Qh P), followed by exact restriction of the pinned counit for k and the exact restriction localization factor, equals the selected derived composition comparison for U′ inclusion and k, followed by the composite pinned counit and the localized termwise comparison from composite tensor pullback to target restriction. The termwise comparison is constructed from tensorPullbackCompositionIso and openPinnedTensorOpenIso. Definitions and ingredients: [def-pc-open-pinned-single-tensor-restriction-iso], [def-pc-single-complex-open-restriction-data], [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition].

source.place: Tags 08HY, 08DW and 0D5S; derived tensor composition and restriction

proof.text: Reuse the proved private compositionCounit and openCounit identities from OpenPinnedSourceCounitTriangle through a proof-only import all. The first factors the selected composition comparison through successive pinned counits and the inverse ordinary tensor composition comparison. The second factors the inverse open derived comparison through the exact restriction localization factor and the inverse termwise open comparison. mappedHomotopyInvHom cancels the inverse and forward termwise open comparisons. Precompose the open identity by the forward derived comparison and postcompose by the forward termwise comparison; targetOpenFactor gives the forward open factorization.

For targetHomotopyComparison choose a representative complex of P. Both homotopy composition components are quotient maps of termwise comparisons. Their composite in each degree cancels the ordinary composition comparison against its inverse and leaves the open tensor comparison evaluated on the tensor pullback of that degree. Apply Qh and its map_comp equation to obtain the target termwise comparison cancellation.

Naturality of the forward singleComplexOpenPullbackIso component at the pinned counit for k moves exact restriction of this counit to derived open pullback of the counit followed by the open comparison. Substitute the forward open factorization and the compositionCounit identity. The termwise cancellation identifies the remaining two comparison maps with the forward open tensor comparison. targetTriangleAlgebra reassociates these four equations to give the exact displayed target triangle. No counit is canceled and no source open, boundedness, or geometric assumption is introduced.

theorem open_pinned_target_counit_triangle
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (k : X' ⟶ X) (U' : X'.Opens)
    (P : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ)) :
    (singleComplexOpenPullbackIso X' U').hom.app
        ((derivedPullback k).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)) ≫
      (schemeOpenRestriction X' U').mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((pinnedPullbackCounit.{u, w} k).app P) ≫
      (schemeOpenRestriction X' U').mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) |>.obj P) =
    (pinnedPullbackComposition.{u, w} U'.ι k).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P) ≫
      (pinnedPullbackCounit.{u, w} (U'.ι ≫ k)).app P ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((openPinnedHomotopyTargetCompositionIso k U').hom.app P)
